en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 21.13.
Mahantaraduka, Kusalattika

Conditioned by a state that is not object-possessing and not wholesome, a wholesome state that is object-possessing arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is not object-possessing and not unwholesome, an unwholesome state that is object-possessing arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that has various objects and is indeterminate, there arises a state that is objectless and indeterminate by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: one; under predominance-condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: one.
Conditioned by a state that is neither consciousness nor wholesome, there arises a state that is consciousness and wholesome by way of root-condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root-condition: three … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: three. (Three for non-unwholesome; three for non-indeterminate. Abbreviated.)
Conditioned by a mental state that is neither associated with consciousness nor wholesome, a mental state that is wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three [results] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a state that is not associated with consciousness and not wholesome, a state associated with consciousness that is wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root condition: one [formula] … pe … in the case of non-disappearance: one.

Conditioned by a state that is neither associated with consciousness nor wholesome, a state that is associated with consciousness and wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. In the case of root condition:
one … pe … in the case of non-disappearance: one.
Conditioned by a state that is neither mind-originated nor wholesome, a mind-originated wholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three [results] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a state that is neither co-existent with mind nor wholesome, a state co-existent with mind that is wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Conditioned by a state that does not follow the mind and is not wholesome, a wholesome state that follows the mind arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Conditioned by a non-wholesome state that is neither conjoined with nor produced by mind, a wholesome state that is conjoined with and produced by mind arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three [results] under root [condition] … pe … three under non-disappearance [condition].

Conditioned by a non-wholesome state that is co-existent with what is neither conjoined with nor produced by mind, a wholesome state that is conjoined with and co-existent with mind arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.

Conditioned by a non-unassociated-with-consciousness, non-originated, and non-concomitant unwholesome state, a wholesome state that is associated-with-consciousness, originated, and concomitant arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Conditioned by an internal unwholesome state, an internal wholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a non-nutriment unwholesome state, a non-nutriment wholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
Under the root condition: one [formula] … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.
Conditioned by a state that is neither-clung-to-nor-healthy, a state that is clung-to and healthy arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition:
one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.
